name: Grugliasco (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Grugliasco (a heron on red, with a heron crest) within olive and oak branches.
history: Municipal flag of Grugliasco, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Grugliasco arms — heron on red, crowned, within branches
